strings.name: Tawakkol Karman
strings.summary: Karman used journalism and nonviolent organizing in Yemen’s democracy movement. She co-founded Women Journalists Without Chains and advocated free expression and women’s participation. Prominent in the 2011 uprising, she shared the Nobel Peace Prize with Sirleaf and Gbowee. Her foundation later supported schools and relief; she continues speaking on democracy, war and accountability.
